FOREIGN LANGUAGE TRAINING REIMBURSEMENT

To promote ongoing skills growth, the firm has agreed ------- (139) a new tuition assistance policy for language courses. Effective in August, course charges for permitted language programmes related to a worker's present duties will be covered.

To be considered for funding, you must first secure permission from your line manager. The following step is to finish the course. ------- (140), you will forward the invoice and a copy of the certificate to the payroll office for checking. ------- (141)

We trust this encouragement will boost both your prospects and our market standing. All permanent staff members with at least twelve months of service are eligible for this ------- (142).
